hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */kubeconfig|*/terraform/*.tfstate*|*/certs/*) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: %s is a gitignored, high-blast-radius file (kubeconfig / terraform state / internal CA cert). Edit it outside Claude Code."}}' "$f" ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; out=""; case "$f" in *.yml|*.yaml) command -v yamllint >/dev/null 2>&1 && out=$(yamllint -c .yamllint.yml "$f" 2>&1) ;; *.tf) command -v terraform >/dev/null 2>&1 && out=$(terraform fmt "$f" 2>&1) ;; esac; if [ -n "$out" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":%s}}' "$(printf '%s' "$out" | jq -Rs .)"; fi; }
